evals.prompt: Set up Scruple in a pnpm TypeScript project using OXC, the Jev provider, and the resources plugin. Enable require-cleanup-on-failure as an error and keep the API key out of source control.
evals.expected_output: Creates or proposes a defineConfig-based scruple.config.ts, reads TYPESAFE_API_KEY from the environment with a clear missing-value failure, registers resources under a namespace, separately enables resources/require-cleanup-on-failure as error, installs only required packages, and gives a relevant verification command without exposing a credential.

evals.prompt: I added comments() under plugins in scruple.config.ts, but I want every comments rule to run automatically. Fix the config.
evals.expected_output: Explains that plugin registration intentionally does not enable rules, inspects the plugin's current exported rule names, and adds explicit namespaced entries with deliberate severities rather than inventing an all-rules switch.

evals.prompt: Scruple says Rule quality/no-useless-comments requires plugin quality. My plugins object is { comments: comments() }. Diagnose and make the smallest correction.
evals.expected_output: Identifies the consumer-owned namespace mismatch and either changes the rule ID to comments/no-useless-comments or deliberately renames the plugin key; makes only one consistent correction and verifies the config.
